title: Watch Duty: Mend the Fences
summary: The village's fences are broken in a dozen places. The Watch needs timber and stone.

dialogue.intro: The fences are down in a dozen places. If raiders come, they'll walk straight in.
offer: Timber and stone. Thirty-two cobblestone, sixteen oak logs.
dialogue.return: We're still short of timber and stone.
dialogue.reward: That'll mend every gap. Here, from the Watch.
